title: Install
description: Install Canon with Homebrew: one cask for Canon.app and the canon CLI, or one formula for the CLI alone. You can also run it from source with Node.js 22+.

items: macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel.

blocks.text: To run Canon from its Git repository, you need Node.js 22 or newer and a clone of the repository:

blocks.source:
git clone https://github.com/oncanon/canon.git
cd canon
npm ci --offline   # dev tooling only; safe to skip if you trust node_modules already present
node src/cli.mjs   # prints usage
